queries: WITH hand_tallies AS (SELECT p.throws AS throwing_hand, COUNT(*) AS tally FROM manager_award AS ma JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id GROUP BY p.throws), shares AS (SELECT tally, 1.0 * tally / SUM(tally) OVER () AS share FROM hand_tallies), compared AS (SELECT tally, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS overall_average_share FROM shares) SELECT SUM(tally) AS combined_tally, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - overall_average_share) AS average_amount_above_average FROM compared WHERE share > overall_average_share;

WITH hand_counts AS (SELECT p.throws AS throwing_hand, COUNT(*) AS tally FROM manager_award AS ma JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id GROUP BY p.throws), hand_shares AS (SELECT throwing_hand, tally, 1.0 * tally / SUM(tally) OVER () AS share FROM hand_counts), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS share FROM hand_shares) SELECT SUM(h.tally) AS combined_tally, AVG(h.share) AS average_share, AVG(h.share - a.share) AS average_above_overall_share FROM hand_shares AS h CROSS JOIN average_share AS a WHERE h.share > a.share;
